 Theme System Architecture

AC Grid's theme system uses an independent package architecture:



 Why Independent Packages?

Sorting

AC Grid provides powerful sorting capabilities that allow users to organize data by clicking column headers.

 Quick Start

Sorting is enabled by default in AC Grid. Users can simply click column headers to sort data.

Sorting is enabled by default. To disable sorting on specific columns, set enableSorting: false.

Getting Started with AC Grid

AC Grid is a fully open source data grid to replace AG Grid. It's framework-agnostic, built with Web Components and @tanstack/table-corehttps://tanstack.com/table/latest.

 Installation



 Quick Start

 With a bundler Vite, Webpack, etc.
